prompt: Review the first Mermaid architecture diagram in docs/architecture/architecture.md. The retrieval and generation arrows are visually attached to the wrong boxes. Fix the diagram while preserving the V1 Pipecat target and legacy bridge distinction.

The generation labels are attached to the Mistral/Ollama interactions rather than ambiguous internal backend handoffs.
